REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-54087  Recommendation to receive and file Director’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Thursday, December 19, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  15270 (Projects Which Are Disapproved) of the CEQA Guidelines; and

  Deny a Conditional Use Permit (CUP24-008), and adopt the proposed findings
  related thereto, to operate a 1,722-square-foot outdoor recycling collection center
  with an attendant in the parking lot of a site developed with an existing 2,928-
  square-foot warehouse located at 2805 East South Street. The existing industrial
  building would remain and is not part of the proposed project. This project is being
  reviewed under the Light Industrial (IL) Zoning District standards, which was the
  zoning district in effect at the time of project filing. The site was rezoned in October
  2024 to the Neo-Industrial 2 (NI-2) Zoning District as part of the UPLAN Phase II
  Rezoning Project. (District 9)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Planning Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Vanessa Hall, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.

at https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101 or
cityclerk@longbeach.gov.
